purpose: Third LIBERO-Plus 280 panel (panel C) so BF16 and the W2/W3 QuIP#, GPTVQ, QTIP arms each reach 840 closed-loop episodes (panels A + B + C); W3 arms also run panel B here; same runtime as fastwam-a16-baselines-20261028 (dequantized dense BF16 weights, T5 cache, condition cache + CUDA Graph)

panel_c.selection: from each of the 28 suite/dimension cells of the 1,400-row official pilot pool, drop the 10 panel-A and 10 panel-B variants and pick 10 of the remaining 30 with the panel-A greedy balance (original_task, subtype, task/subtype pair, difficulty), seed 20261101 + cell index
panel_c.seeds: slot index = 560 + position, so env seed 800000000 + 1000*index and sampler seeds 900000000 + 1000*index + replan never repeat panels A or B
panel_c.invalid_rule: a variant whose task completes during the 30 dummy settling steps is invalid; settling uses no policy action, so validity is the same for every arm and the slot is dropped from every arm

earlier_panels: panel A of every arm comes from the A16 loops (BF16: rotation-baselines JSONL); panel B of the W2 arms and BF16 from fastwam-plus-panelb-20261031 (job 26070795)

schedule.rule: every worker slot picks the arm with the most unclaimed episodes per worker (unclaimed / (active + 1)); it joins an arm that already has workers only if unclaimed / active >= join_min, so a reload (~4 min) is paid only while the arm still has several episodes per worker left; ties go to the earlier arm in arm_order; episodes are claimed by atomic mkdir on GPFS

allocation.ncpus_basis: 8 loop workers ~2 busy cores each (a16g3 cpupercent 1657 with 8 workers) + T5 build; PBS may raise it to 16 per GPU, worker threads follow Resource_List.ncpus
allocation.time_basis: 2,800 episodes x ~78 s (26070795 per-arm means 76.9-81.1 s) / 8 slots ~7.6 h, plus ~10 min T5 and the first load; the tail reloads ~6 x 4 min
allocation.gpu_memory_note: one worker holds ~14.8 GB on an A100-40GB, so two slots per GPU
